CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the Paralysed Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the Lost Sheep and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Ruler 3 3.9 A Friend at Midnight 3 Page 12 of 87 xii 4.0 The Chur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
